svg.title: AgenticIterRag AIR v1 Training and Inference Pipeline
svg.desc: A professional four-stage schematic for AgenticIterRag AIR v1: search-agent training, reranker data production, LLM reranker training, and assembled inference with trained agent and trained reranker.
svg.text: Train the search agent, produce reranker data, train the LLM reranker, then assemble the final agentic RAG inference stack.
